outcome: claims documentation of any Z code (prenatal period)
claims documentation of any Z code (60 days post partum)
claims documentation of any Z code (12 months post partum)
claims documentation of any Z code (full perinatal period)
documentation of specific Z codes (e.g., housing, food insecurity)
cohort: The study included 79,293 Medicaid-enrolled live deliveries among people 18 years or older in Massachusetts between January 31, 2016, and December 31, 2020.
finding: Medicaid ACO implementation was associated with statistically significant increases in documentation of any Z code, housing or economic circumstances codes, and food insecurity codes in claims, primarily in the prenatal period.
